risks.name: Short-code collision
risks.mitigation: UNIQUE constraint + up to 5 retries, then 503; collision counter metric

risks.name: Timezone bug on expiry
risks.mitigation: Normalise to naive UTC at the schema boundary; reject past expiry

risks.name: Alias shadows a route (e.g. /docs)
risks.mitigation: Reserved alias list; alias charset excludes dots and slashes

risks.name: Creation floods / abuse
risks.mitigation: Per-client rate limit (429); auth and URL scanning are documented next steps

risks.name: Hot links overload the database
risks.mitigation: Read-through Redis cache for code -> URL; CDN for very hot links

risks.name: Analytics write amplification
risks.mitigation: Queue + batch inserts, pre-aggregated counters, time-partitioned clicks

risks.name: SQLite single-writer limit
risks.mitigation: Accepted for the prototype; PostgreSQL in production

risks.name: Generated code merged without review
risks.mitigation: Sandboxed workspace, verification gate and human sign-off before merge

failure_scenarios.behaviour: Redirect still served; click lost and logged
Retries, then 503 so clients back off
Rejected; retried with the error; fallback or halt
Feedback loop re-opens code generation (bounded rounds)

validation_strategy: contract: served API matches the contract
Tests are generated from the contract, independently of the code, so they are not shaped by its bugs
Contract drift is checked against the OpenAPI the generated service actually serves
Repair loop: 1 round(s) used this run (max 2) before the result reached review
Human gates on requirement interpretation, plan, and final sign-off
Live smoke test before merge: uvicorn + curl create/redirect/analytics
limitations: Prototype: SQLite, in-process rate limiter and metrics, no auth, no migrations tool
Offline reference provider: deterministic rules and a curated reference implementation; real synthesis needs a model provider
